command: cd data && uv run python -m pulsar_vision.yawdd

dataset.name: YawDD
dataset.citation: S. Abtahi, M. Omidyeganeh, S. Shirmohammadi, and B. Hariri, "YawDD: A Yawning Detection Dataset", Proc. ACM Multimedia Systems, Singapore, March 19-21 2014.
dataset.license: YawDD videos are for non-commercial and research purposes only. Screenshots are allowed only for the videos whose row in the dataset tables says so; this pipeline writes no frames, crops or images.
dataset.labels: One label per video, from the file name. No per-frame labels.

Mirror/Male_mirror Avi Videos/20-MaleGla: condition not capitalised as in the rest of the dataset

feature.name: inner_lip_gap_over_outer_eye_corner_distance_2d_px
feature.formula: dist(upper_inner_lip, lower_inner_lip) / dist(right_eye_outer, left_eye_outer), 2D Euclidean distance in pixels (x * image_width, y * image_height)

detector.rule: mouth_open_ratio >= on threshold, kept while >= off threshold, for at least min_duration_s
detector.tie_break: candidate closest to the centre of the tied region of the grid

validation.scheme: 5 folds grouped by subject (camera + sex + participant number), stratified by sex

talking_and_yawning_videos.note: Reported apart; never used to choose parameters. Each should contain at least one yawn.
Reported apart; never used to choose parameters. Each should contain at least one yawn.

variant_chosen_on_train_folds.note: Per fold, the variant with the higher train score (absolute on a tie) is applied to the test fold.

talking_and_yawning_videos.note: Reported apart; never used to choose parameters. Each should contain at least one yawn.

results.chosen_by: Higher out-of-fold selection score (recall on Yawning minus the mean false-alarm rate on Talking and Normal); absolute on a tie because it needs no baseline. Choosing between two variants on the out-of-fold score is slightly optimistic; see variant_chosen_on_train_folds for the estimate without it.

in_sample_metrics.note: Same videos used to choose the parameters: optimistic, not a validation result.
Same videos used to choose the parameters: optimistic, not a validation result.

longest_open_episode_s_at_final_threshol.note: Longest stretch above the final absolute threshold, per Mirror video, by condition.

baseline_check.note: The relative variant takes the median ratio of the first seconds as the person's resting mouth. YawDD does not guarantee a calm start: the numbers below measure it.
baseline_check.first_yawn_measured_with: final absolute parameters; Yawning videos with a detected yawn only

runs_of_frames_without_a_face.note: Mirror videos. A run next to an open mouth means the face was lost while the mouth was open.

max_gap_sensitivity.note: Out-of-fold result of the absolute variant if max_gap_s had another value (same folds, same search). max_gap_s must exceed the time between two processed frames, or no stretch can ever last.

dash_descriptive.note: Dash videos mix normal, talking and yawning with no time annotations. These are counts of what the detector fires on, with the final parameters; they are not an accuracy measurement.

alternative_features.note: Same folds, same search, absolute thresholds. For information only: the detector parameters use the product formula. Each row is the out-of-fold result if that measure replaced it.

timing.note: Per-frame time is FaceLandmarker.detect_for_video in Python on this machine's CPU, measured while several worker processes ran at once. It is not a browser measurement.
